A guide to internal projects and tasks is available on the Guide to Projects and Tasks in Timesheets.xlsx Goal is to be accurate—especially on client work—but we are not looking for you to account minute by minute If you believe a client project is missing or have any questions about where to log your time, please let Dan D. or Christina W. know
- This email was sent automatically from Salesforce. If you feel this email reached you in error, or if you are experiencing any issues with the Timesheets app in Salesforce, please reach out to Adam S. with your concerns.
